conversation.title: Robotics team field-test review
conversation.summary: The team reviewed reliability problems and reporting requests after a delivery-robot field test.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: The delivery rover loses Wi-Fi behind the engineering building and never reconnects unless we restart it.

utterances.speaker: Dev
utterances.text: So the connection manager should recover on its own when the network comes back?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Yes, please make the robot reconnect automatically instead of waiting for a reboot.

utterances.speaker: Owen
utterances.text: Dev, please add a CSV export of route durations before our next field test, and put battery temperature on the live dashboard.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Maybe someday it could play a little song when it arrives, but that is not work for this semester.
